 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] in (1, 2)]
    (r1, c1, _), (r2, c2, _) = sorted(points, key=lambda p: p[2])
    dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1 if r2 < r1 else 0
    dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1 if c2 < c1 else 0
    # Use diagonal strokes at both ends, with the excess displacement as a straight middle stroke.
    diagonal = min(abs(r2-r1), abs(c2-c1)) - 1
    r, c = r1, c1
    for _ in range(max(0, diagonal)):
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    while (r, c) != (r2-dr, c2-dc):
        if r != r2-dr:
            r += dr
        elif c != c2-dc:
            c += dc
        else:
            break
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    demo = [[0]*12 for _ in range(13)]

    for r,c in [(4,7),(4,8),(4,9),(4,10),(5,6),(6,5),(7,4),(8,3),(9,2)]: expected[r][c]=3
